subject: Medford High School Building Committee
overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed the MSBA process for Medford High School, established standing subcommittees for the new term, and discussed forming the high school building committee ahead of a planned committee of the whole. It also approved a new assistant food service director position, updated a bullying policy, and directed regular reporting on school security cameras.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on DESE's triennial review of English learner programs, announced upcoming kindergarten registration dates, and highlighted the 100th day of school and upcoming February vacation.

items.title: Assistant Food Service Director Job Description
items.summary: Approved the job description for a new assistant food services director position as amended to include culturally inclusive language.

items.title: McGlynn Playground Fundraising Update
items.summary: Communications Director Thomas Dalton presented an update on the newly created online donation portal and outreach strategy supporting construction of the accessible McGlynn Elementary playground.

items.title: MSBA Timeline Overview
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent outlined the 270-day eligibility period starting May 1, 2024, and subsequent stages in the Massachusetts School Building Authority core project for Medford High School.

items.title: Report on Status of School Committee Goals
items.summary: The superintendent updated the committee on the seven goals approved in 2023, noting that six were completed and only additional town hall meetings remain in progress.

items.title: Formation of Medford High School Building Committee
items.summary: Approved a motion to discuss forming the Medford High School Building Committee, voted to create an MSBA FAQ, and referred the committee structure and application process to an end-of-February committee of the whole.

items.title: Bullying Prevention Policy Update
items.summary: Approved removing the phrase 'three or more incidents' from the district's Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan policy and waived the second reading.

items.title: Security Camera Status Reporting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the school IT director to provide monthly status reports on security cameras to city and school administration and replace broken cameras within 45 days.

items.title: School Committee Subcommittees for 2024-2025
items.summary: Approved standing subcommittee appointments through December 31, 2025, following member survey feedback.

items.title: Ad Hoc Committee on School Handbooks
items.summary: Approved the establishment of an ad hoc subcommittee and appointed members Olapade, Reinfeld, and Ruseau to develop a standard review process for annual school handbooks.

items.title: Condolence
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Paula A. Gianelli-Coughlin, a Medford Public Schools early childhood educator.
